title: fill-in block props
description: « Texte à trous »: a text with blanks the learner fills, typed, chosen from menus or placed from a bank of words. Blanks are written in the Markdown as [[answer|other accepted answer]]; the build turns them into blanks and keeps their answers out of the text. Scored by the share of its blanks right; correct when all are. After the last try the right answers show in place.
x-ai-instructions: Use it to recall key terms, values or steps in their context (retrieval practice). Blank the word that carries the idea, never a trivial one, and keep one to three blanks per sentence and a dozen at most: the sentence must stay readable around them. Give every accepted spelling or synonym after | ([[DNS|serveur DNS]]). presentation typed (default) asks to produce the word: the strongest retrieval, for terms learners must write; menus gives a list per blank: recognition, quicker on phones, for words with tricky spellings; bank gives the words to place: easiest, for a first practice. With menus and bank add two or three plausible distractors (words of the same kind as the answers). Always write feedback.incorrect that explains the rule or the clue without giving the answers, and feedback.correct that says why.

presentation.description: How the learner fills the blanks: typed (a field per blank), menus (a list per blank: every blank's answer and the distractors, in a fixed shuffled order), bank (the words to place: choose a word, then its blank; drag works too with a mouse). Switching it never changes the words.

stem.description: Instruction or question above the text (Complétez la procédure.).

markdown.description: The text with its blanks: [[answer]] or [[answer|other accepted|another]]. The first answer is the one shown after the last try (and the word a bank or a menu offers). Translate the answers with their sentence.

distractors.description: menus and bank: wrong words offered with the answers.

ignoreAccents.description: typed: accept an answer written without its accents (« eleve » for « élève »). Case, spaces around the word and the form of quotes and apostrophes never count.

scored.description: Counts in the course score (the share of its blanks right).

attempts.description: Tries before the answers are final.

showCorrectAnswer.description: After the last try, show the right answer in each wrong blank.
